name: idle
action: Await agent verb / provision / DAV request / export / close

name: route_verb
action: Classify verb: landing vs compute vs cache-lifecycle (mcp.json instructions R13.5)
transition: deterministic repo-local verb -> S2; heavy verb needing bulk exchange -> S3

name: landing_exec
action: gate.py assembles PYTHONPATH over packages/*, runs pure-python verb against --repo tree, writes directly into caller repo, emits JSON envelope or typed LANDING_* error
transition: verb completed or typed error -> S0

name: cache_provision
action: Resolve identity (Basic credential), find-or-mint deliverable-cache token, return mount URL + credential
transition: cache provisioned; inputs staged via DAV mount -> S4

name: heavy_compute
action: Container tool reads cache tree; pcbnew/ngspice/OpenSCAD/render pipeline runs; artifacts written into cache namespace
transition: host-side inspects/edits over WebDAV -> S5; deliverable ready -> S6

name: dav_serve
action: Dispatch DAV method (PROPFIND/GET/PUT/MKCOL/MOVE/COPY/LOCK) with identity + traversal + lock guards + audit log
transition: next heavy tool call in relay chain -> S4

name: export_land
action: Export cache tree to caller truth store, stamp last_export_at; typed EXPORT_TARGET_UNREACHABLE on bad target
transition: export landed clean; close requested -> S7; further iterations -> S4

name: close_reap
action: Verify working tree clean since last export (or force), close cache, reaper frees namespace

name: blocked
action: Typed error surfaced (AUTH_*, LANDING_PACKAGES_NOT_FOUND, WORKSPACE_CLOSE_DIRTY, EXPORT_TARGET_UNREACHABLE) — no silent fallback
transition: caller resolves (credential / packages / export / force) -> resume prior step
